     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _DOC_MACRO = re.compile(r'(?<!\w)(?:(?P<kind>[IBMUCRL])\((?P<value>[^)]+)\)|(?P<rule>HORIZONTALLINE))(?!\w)')
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            if match.group('rule'):
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            kind = match.group('kind')
+            value = match.group('value')
+            if kind in ('L', 'R'):
+                label, comma, target = value.partition(',')
+                if not comma:
+                    return match.group(0)
+                if kind == 'L':
+                    return '%s <%s>' % (label.rstrip(' '), target.lstrip(' '))
+                return label
+            if kind in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % value
+            if kind == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if kind == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            return value  # U()
+
+        return cls._DOC_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocTtyify(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_links_and_references(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('L(Ansible,https://example.com) and L(guide, https://example.com/guide); '
+                           'R(related topic,reference) and R(other topic, reference)'),
+            'Ansible <https://example.com> and guide <https://example.com/guide>; '
+            'related topic and other topic',
+        )
+
+    def test_horizontal_line(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('HORIZONTALLINE'), '\n-------------\n')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('above HORIZONTALLINE below'),
+                         'above \n-------------\n below')
+
+    def test_mixed_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('IBM(International Business Machines) M(name) B(text) C(value) '
+                           'R(topic,ref) I(italic) U(https://example.com) plain'),
+            "IBM(International Business Machines) [name] *text* `value' "
+            "topic `italic' https://example.com plain",
+        )
+
+    def test_unsupported_text_is_unchanged(self):
+        text = 'IBM(International Business Machines) X(other) L(no comma) HORIZONTALLINES'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), text)
